title: The shape of the spread
description: Horizontal quartile boxes, median ticks, capped whiskers and independent outliers share one numeric scale.

props.name: data
props.description: Caller-owned { id, label, summary, outliers? } rows. Summary is an ordered finite [lowerWhisker, q1, median, q3, upperWhisker] tuple or null; signed values are supported. Outliers are independent caller-classified { id, label?, value } observations; nonfinite or null readings are omitted and counted. Row IDs must be unique and nonempty, as must outlier IDs within each row. Quartile method and whisker policy remain caller-owned. Equal quartiles use a median tick without manufacturing box width.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned reporting context, units or statistical policy.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats absolute readings and tooltip values; axis ticks use compact numbers. Defaults to en-US with up to two decimals.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense plots and keys scroll inside the frame.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native drawing using scoped motion tokens and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible title for the native chart.
